title: The Weekend - Funky Galaxy Battles

segments.zh: 各位英语学习者，大家好。

segments.en: And today we have a special lesson for all our sci-fi or science fiction fans.
segments.zh: 今天，我们为所有科幻小说或科幻迷提供了一个特别的课程。

segments.en: Yes, and actually one special user was the inspiration for this lesson.
segments.zh: 是的，实际上一位特殊用户是本课的灵感来源。

segments.en: Well, sci-fi is very popular, Star Trek, Star Wars.
segments.zh: 好吧，科幻很受欢迎，星际迷航，星球大战。

segments.en: And well, there are some really interesting words that maybe you wouldn't use in real life or in normal circumstances.
segments.zh: 好吧，有一些非常有趣的词可能你不会在现实生活或正常情况下使用。

segments.en: But you do want to understand these movies or why they say these words, right?
segments.zh: 但是你确实想了解这些电影，或者他们为什么说这些话，对吧？

segments.en: So we're going to look at some sci-fi language in this lesson.
segments.zh: 所以我们将在本课中看一些科幻语言。

segments.en: But before we start, let's look at Vocabulary Preview.
segments.zh: 但在我们开始之前，让我们看看词汇预览。

segments.en: And in Vocabulary Preview today, we have one phrase only.
segments.zh: 在今天的词汇预览中，我们只有一个短语。

segments.en: You don't know which one it is.
A spacecraft is a vehicle that travels in space.
segments.zh: 航天器是在太空中行驶的车辆。

segments.en: Actually, this is interesting because you know the word UFO.
segments.zh: 实际上，这很有趣，因为您知道 UFO 这个词。

segments.en: So unidentified spacecraft, an unknown vehicle flying in space.
segments.zh: 所以 unidentified spacecraft，就是在太空中飞行的未知飞行器。

segments.en: Have you ever seen a UFO?
Well, I think the people in our dialogue may or may not have seen a UFO.
segments.zh: 好吧，我认为我们对话中的人可能也可能没有看到不明飞行物。

segments.en: So why don't we take a listen?
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不听一听呢？

segments.en: Set your blasters to full power.
segments.zh: 把爆能枪调到最大火力。

segments.en: She's got to be in here somewhere.
segments.zh: 她肯定就在这飞船上的某个地方。

segments.en: Lord Hater, we have a survivor here.
segments.zh: 海特勋爵，我们发现一名幸存者。

segments.en: She will no longer be your prisoner.
It's time you and I settled this once and for all.
segments.zh: 是时候把我们之间的恩怨彻底了结了。

segments.en: You are unwise to think you can defeat me.
segments.zh: 以为能打败我，你太天真了。

segments.en: You know nothing of the power of the obscure side.
segments.zh: 你对晦暗之力一无所知。

segments.en: Lord Hater, we have an unidentified spacecraft taking off from the rear dock.
segments.zh: 海特勋爵，有一艘身份不明的飞船正从后方船坞起飞。

segments.en: They somehow managed to escape our tractor beam.
segments.zh: 他们不知怎么逃出了我们的牵引光束。

segments.en: They're accelerating towards the speed of light.
segments.zh: 他们正加速到接近光速。

segments.en: Okay, so a really cool Lord Hater, huh?
segments.zh: 好吧，很酷的 Lord Hater，对吧？

segments.en: Well, you may have noticed that it's similar to a certain movie out there.
segments.zh: 好吧，您可能已经注意到它类似于那里的某个电影。

segments.en: I mean, it seems quite original to me.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，在我看来这挺原创的。
但一切都是为了教育目的。

segments.en: Okay, so we saw some words that were maybe a little bit difficult.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们看到了一些可能有点困难的词。

segments.en: So let's take a look at these now in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 因此，让我们在语言要点中看看这些。

segments.en: Well, I guess in the dialogue, the bad guys were breaking through.
segments.zh: 好吧，我猜在对话中，坏人正在突破。

segments.en: In the simple present, it would be?
segments.zh: 用一般现在时来说就是？

segments.en: Well, let's listen to some examples to help us find out.
segments.zh: 好吧，让我们听一些例子来帮助我们找出答案。

segments.en: After 15 minutes, the workers broke through the wall and rescued everyone from the fire.
segments.zh: 15分钟后，工人们冲破了墙壁，将所有人从火中救了出来。

segments.en: He is such a good player.
He broke through the entire defense.
They are breaking through our impenetrable wall.
segments.zh: 他们正在冲破我们无法穿透的墙。

segments.en: All right, so it's kind of like to enter by force somewhere.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以有点像在某个地方强行进入。

segments.en: Yeah, to maybe break some glass and come into a room or something like that.
segments.zh: 是的，也许打破一些玻璃并进入一个房间或类似的东西。

segments.en: All right, so Lord Hater had a fight with his enemy and he said he wants to settle this.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以海特勋爵和敌人打了一架，他说他想把这事做个了断。

segments.en: So what do you do when you settle something?
segments.zh: 那么当你解决问题时你会怎么做？

segments.en: Well, when you settle something is you end a fight or a dispute.
segments.zh: 好吧，当你解决某件事时，你结束了一场战斗或一场争执。

segments.en: Or an argument or a problem.
Yeah, when you settle an argument, does everyone always agree?
segments.zh: 是的，当你解决争论时，每个人都同意吗？

segments.en: Sometimes you are forced to agree.
Not everyone agrees, but you have no other choice.
segments.zh: 不是每个人都同意，但你别无选择。

segments.en: So it's a little bit different from reaching an agreement because there's usually a winner and a loser.
segments.zh: 所以这与达成协议有点不同，因为通常有赢家和输家。

segments.en: Well, now another very popular word and within sci-fi is this word tractor beam.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在另一个非常流行的词，在科幻里就是 tractor beam 这个词。

segments.en: Now, I'm not sure if this really exists in real life.
segments.zh: 现在，我不确定这是否真的存在于现实生活中。

segments.en: Well, I've never heard of it.
But a tractor beam in sci-fi movies is like this invisible force that grabs an object and doesn't let it escape and brings it towards another spaceship.
segments.zh: 但科幻电影里的牵引光束就像一种无形的力量，它抓住物体，不让它逃掉，并把它带向另一艘飞船。

segments.en: So it's like almost like a rope that you can't see.
segments.zh: 所以它几乎就像一根你看不到的绳子。

segments.en: Right, and it brings it in.
So the spaceship managed to escape their tractor beam.
segments.zh: 所以宇宙飞船设法摆脱了他们的牵引光束。

segments.en: Okay, I think that is definitely not true.
segments.zh: 好吧，我认为这绝对不是真的。

segments.en: But in sci-fi you will always hear this tractor beam.
segments.zh: 但在科幻片里你总会听到这个牵引光束。

segments.en: Now, let's move on to our final word.
segments.zh: 现在，让我们继续最后一个词。

segments.en: The spaceship was accelerating towards the speed of light.
segments.zh: 宇宙飞船正朝着光速加速。

segments.en: So that means to increase speed, right?
segments.zh: 所以这意味着提高速度，对吧？

segments.en: So if you are in your car.
segments.zh: 所以如果你在你的车里。

segments.en: You want to accelerate so you can pass another car.
segments.zh: 你想加速，好超越另一辆车。

segments.en: Or even when you stop at a red light and it turns green.
segments.zh: 或者当你在红灯前停下、灯变绿时。

segments.en: Let's listen to our dialogue again and then we'll come back and take a look at some of the phrases that came up in this dialogue.
segments.zh: 让我们再听一次我们的对话，然后我们会回来看看这个对话中出现的一些短语。

segments.en: Lord Hater, we have an unidentified spacecraft taking off from the rear dock.
segments.zh: 哈特勋爵，我们有一艘不明身份的航天器从后码头起飞。

segments.en: They somehow managed to escape our tractor beam.
segments.zh: 他们不知怎么逃出了我们的牵引光束。

segments.en: They're accelerating towards the speed of light.
segments.zh: 他们正加速到接近光速。

segments.en: I think that's a little bit more clear this time.
segments.zh: 我认为这一次更清楚一点。

segments.en: But like Marco said, I want to look at now some phrases that you might hear in a sci-fi context.
segments.zh: 但就像 Marco 说的，我现在想看看你可能在科幻背景下听到的一些短语。

segments.en: The first phrase that we can take a look at and maybe it looks a little bit strange.
segments.zh: 我们可以看的第一个短语可能看起来有点奇怪。

segments.en: He said she will no longer be your prisoner.
segments.zh: 他说她不再是你的囚犯。

segments.en: So what does he mean by no longer?
segments.zh: 那么他说的不再是什么意思呢？

segments.en: Yeah, so you will not be my prisoner anymore.
segments.zh: 是的，所以你不会再做我的囚犯了。

segments.en: Okay, so how would I use it in this form?
segments.zh: 好的，我将如何在这种形式中使用它？

segments.en: You've always got to use it in the future tense.
segments.zh: 你总是必须在未来时使用它。

segments.en: Okay, so she'll no longer be your prisoner.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以她将不再是你的囚犯。

segments.en: I will no longer be your employee.
Okay, or I can say I will no longer be your boyfriend.
segments.zh: 好吧，或者我可以说我不会再做你的男朋友了。

segments.en: Okay, so it's always will no longer be.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以总是 will no longer be。

segments.en: Is this quite commonly used or maybe a little bit formal?
segments.zh: 这是很常用的还是有点正式的？

segments.en: I think it's a little bit formal and it's very, I don't know, to a certain point poetic.
segments.zh: 我认为它有点正式，而且我不知道，在某种程度上是诗意的。

segments.en: Yeah, which I think is why we hear it a little bit more often in sci-fi movies.
segments.zh: 是的，我想这就是为什么我们在科幻电影中更频繁地听到它的原因。

segments.en: All right, so no longer be.
You know nothing of the power of the obscure side.
segments.zh: 你对晦涩的一面的力量一无所知。
再说一次，它非常有诗意。

segments.en: Yeah, basically meaning you don't know about.
segments.zh: 是的，基本上意味着你不知道。

segments.en: So again, let's take a look at how you would use it.
segments.zh: 再说一遍，让我们看看你将如何使用它。

segments.en: You know nothing of and then.
You know nothing of science fiction.
segments.zh: 你对科幻小说一无所知。

segments.en: So you would use a noun afterwards.
segments.zh: 所以你会在之后使用名词。

segments.en: Again, formal and probably quite often used in science fiction movies.
segments.zh: 同样，正式且可能经常用于科幻电影。

segments.en: But now you can understand when they use some of these words that maybe are a little bit difficult and very common in these types of movies.
segments.zh: 但现在，他们在电影里用到那些有点难、却很常见的词时，你就能听懂了。

segments.en: Now let's go to our last phrase.
segments.zh: 现在让我们进入我们的最后一句话。

segments.en: And this one actually can be used in many different circumstances.
segments.zh: 而这一款实际上可以在许多不同的情况下使用。

segments.en: Let's settle this once and for all.
segments.zh: 让我们一劳永逸地解决这个问题。

segments.en: Okay, so we saw the word settle already.
segments.zh: 好的，settle 这个词我们已经见过了。

segments.en: Now let's settle this once and for all.
segments.zh: 现在让我们一劳永逸地解决这个问题。

segments.en: Okay, so once and for all, forever.
So why don't we listen to some other examples of how we can use this phrase once and for all in different contexts.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不听一些其他例子来说明我们如何在不同的上下文中一劳永逸地使用这个短语。

segments.en: I'm fed up with arguing about this.
Let's just settle the argument once and for all.
segments.zh: 让我们一劳永逸地解决这个论点。

segments.en: He claims his photographs prove once and for all that UFOs do exist.
segments.zh: 他声称他的照片一劳永逸地证明了不明飞行物的存在。

segments.en: I told him once and for all that I don't want to be his girlfriend anymore.
segments.zh: 我一劳永逸地告诉他，我不想再做他的女朋友了。

segments.en: Okay, so now I think it's clear.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在我认为这很清楚。

segments.en: We've seen a lot of words.
We've seen a lot of phrases.
Let's listen to our dialogue one more time.
segments.zh: 让我们再听一次我们的对话。

segments.en: Set your blasters to full power.
segments.zh: 把爆能枪调到最大火力。

segments.en: She's got to be in here somewhere.
segments.zh: 她肯定就在这飞船上的某个地方。

segments.en: Lord Hager, we have a survivor here.
segments.zh: 海格勋爵，我们这里有一个幸存者。

segments.en: She will no longer be your prisoner.
I'm sure you and I settled this once and for all.
segments.zh: 我相信你和我一劳永逸地解决了这个问题。

segments.en: You are unwise to think you can defeat me.
segments.zh: 以为能打败我，你太天真了。

segments.en: You know nothing of the power of the obscure side.
segments.zh: 你对晦涩的一面的力量一无所知。

segments.en: Lord Hager, we have an unidentified spacecraft taking off from the rear dock.
segments.zh: 海格勋爵，我们有一艘不明身份的宇宙飞船从后码头起飞。

segments.en: They somehow managed to escape our tractor beam.
segments.zh: 他们不知怎么逃出了我们的牵引光束。

segments.en: They're accelerating towards the speed of light.
segments.zh: 他们正加速到接近光速。

segments.en: Okay, so are you a big sci-fi fan?
I think as you can tell, no.
Actually, I've seen some of the Star Wars movies, but everyone that I've watched, I've fallen asleep in the middle of.
segments.zh: 实际上，我看过几部《星球大战》，但看过的每一部我都在中间睡着了。

segments.en: Yeah, even in the movie theater.
I fell asleep in the movie theater watching Star Wars.
segments.zh: 我在电影院看《星球大战》睡着了。

segments.en: You're not really into the fantasy side?
segments.zh: 你不太喜欢奇幻那一类？

segments.en: No, the whole time I'm sitting there going, this cannot happen.
segments.zh: 不，我坐在那儿整场都在想：这不可能发生。

segments.en: Well, that's why it's called science fiction, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是为什么它被称为科幻小说，对吧？

segments.en: But it is interesting to some people, and well, behind Star Wars, there is a huge culture.
segments.zh: 但对一些人来说它确实有意思，而且《星球大战》背后有非常庞大的文化。

segments.en: Even some people know some of the languages or symbols that are used in it, or the names of some of the robots and models of spacecraft.
segments.zh: 甚至有些人知道其中使用的一些语言或符号，或者一些机器人和航天器模型的名称。

segments.en: Well, maybe we'll have to come up with Star Wars pods.
segments.zh: 好吧，也许我们该做几期《星球大战》的播客。

segments.en: Well, that's all for today, guys.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是今天的全部，伙计们。

segments.zh: 我希望你喜欢我们的课程。

segments.zh: 当然，如果您有任何问题或意见，您可以将它们留在我们网站 englishpod.com 的评论部分。

segments.en: Well, thanks for listening, you guys, and until next time, goodbye.
segments.zh: 好吧，谢谢你的收听，你们，直到下一次，再见。
